detail.longDescription: 📰 I built r/Feed: a minimal subreddit RSS reader, no build step, no dependencies. Search, read tracking, keyboard nav, 8 sort orders, config sharing across devices. My deployment caches Reddit feeds through a self-hosted rss-cacher on my home server; anyone running their own instance brings their own cache, and the app works without one too. Code: https:// github.com/jcrabapple/rfeed # rss # reddit # selfhosted
